name: url-retirement-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the url-retirement Hugo module, run against the eight hugo builds of ./fixture -- the baseline, configured, degraded, off, multilingual, subpath and canonify environments, plus the hostile one that must fail. The module's output is two plain-text documents, so the specs read the published bytes and assert what they say: which redirect rules were generated and in what order, that the site's hand-written rules survived verbatim ahead of them, that the manifest lists every URL the build actually wrote to disk (derived by walking public/, not from a remembered list), that paginated URLs no sitemap contains are in it, and that a subpath build and a canonified one agree byte for byte. It carries no dependencies -- node --test and node:assert are enough -- so it needs no npm install of its own.
